messages:
Maya R: Free 27" Samsung 4K monitor — barely used, VESA mount, HDMI+DP. Moving out tomorrow, curbside pickup in Mission (24th & Mission) around 10am. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/abcd123
Samir: Interested! Could you post the exact model number?
Maya R: Model: S27R750. No dead pixels, matte finish. Power cable + DP cable included.
Garrett: I can swing by at 10 and grab it if it's still available.
Elena (she/her): If Garrett can't make it I can pick up later in the day — will bring a box. @Maya R could you confirm the width? Need to check my stand clearance.
Maya R: width ~24.2" measured edge-to-edge, weight ~10 lbs. Happy to disassemble stand and wrap in bubble if helpful.
Samir: I'll pass if Garrett is already taking it, thanks though!
OpsBot: Reminder: please don't block the building entrance or leave items in the shared kitchen after hours. :warning:
Maya R: noted. I'll meet on the sidewalk by the coffee cart at 9:55 and move it immediately. I'll DM a live pin. :pin:
Garrett: perfect, cash or Venmo works — I'll bring a large box.
Elena (she/her): also offering the fiddle-leaf fig next to my desk for free if anyone wants it (pot included). would need help carrying. :seedling: :grin:
Maya R: lol yes, free plant if you can carry it. pot's a bit heavy but healthy.
Samir: If the plant's still there after the monitor trade I'll take it and bring a saucer.
Maya R: great — first-come-first-serve. I'll update the thread when picked up. thanks everyone :heart:
